guide.coordinates: All x/y values are pixels from the atlas top-left. X increases right and Y down. Rectangles use x,y,w,h with exclusive right/bottom. Indices are zero-based; source_row and column are one-based.
guide.anchors: anchor is relative to the untrimmed 64x64 frame. The fixed rendering pivot (32,32) matches src/assets/sprites.ts actor px/py. anchor_in_atlas is a locator, not a second offset. Anchor is not measured from feet or visible bounds; never recenter crouches, leaps, falls or empty death frames.
guide.draw_formula: For a world/screen anchor (dx,dy) and scale s: drawImage(atlas, rect.x,rect.y,64,64, dx-anchor.x*s,dy-anchor.y*s,64*s,64*s). normalized anchor (0.5,0.5) is the same pivot.
guide.visible_bounds: Optional tight alpha bounds within the frame, for inspection only. Null means fully transparent (intentional on some death endings). Frames are not trimmed or rotated.
guide.flame_center_anchor: Where present, the RGB-key flame pixel centroid in frame-local coordinates, useful as a VFX/light attachment point. It is not the torch grip, mesh tip or rendering pivot.
guide.directions: Each animation block contains eight rows: north,northeast,east,southeast,south,southwest,west,northwest. Columns play left to right. Atlas block placement is arbitrary: always use listed frame rects.
guide.timing: gameplay durations use explicit frame_durations_ms first, then gameplay_frame_duration_ms, otherwise 1000/fps. Preview-only holds remain separate and must not silently replace gameplay timing. Original metadata is embedded for end states and action-specific decisions.
guide.loop: Use animation.loop and source metadata for one-shot endings. If source omitted loop, only idle/walk/run were inferred to loop, with loop_inferred_from_action_name=true.
guide.palette_swap: For lit PLAYER frame rectangles only, start from the unchanged base pixels; replace exact base outer/middle/core RGB with the selected copper/sodium/strontium roles. Preserve all alpha and all other RGB. Apply to frame regions only, never labels, palettes or enemy frames. Several palettes may share RGB values; they are not global atlas-wide remaps.
guide.sampling: Nearest/point filtering, no mipmaps or linear interpolation. Source animation pixels are copied exactly with transparent native margins. Headers and palette panel are opaque reference regions outside frame rects.
guide.integration: This is a combined atlas; existing sheetFrameRect() expects a single 512px-high action sheet and cannot parse this atlas directly. Consume animations[].directions[direction][frame].rect and anchor. Game code has not been changed.
guide.references: All finished main sheets are included once; compact sheets and inspection/showcase PNGs are excluded because they duplicate main-frame content. Palette swatches are included here at the user request; existing individual sheets and separate palette files remain unchanged.
